Eight things it does

Built on the public Squeekchain API and the Squeek contracts.

1 Claim alerts

Get a DM when unclaimed SQK crosses your threshold, and again at every multiple.

2 Claim optimizer

/claim packs the best 32 tokens into one batch and shows the dust left behind.

3 Cooldowns

Know the moment a Squeek leaves cooldown, plus /mergecheck for the full list.

4 Merge ladder

/ladder turns your holdings into an ordered merge plan with the power gain.

5 Hamster status

Running or resting, with live RPM, the heartbeat of the whole chain.

6 Block alerts

Every completed Squeek block, with the SQK it minted.

7 Wallet activity

Transfers, stakes and merges on watched wallets, the safety net for your Squeeks.

8 Quiet hours + digest

Silence at night, one clean summary at the hour you choose.

Commands

Everything runs inside the chat. No dashboard to learn.

/startcreate your account
/watch 0x… labeltrack a wallet (max 5)
/listyour wallets
/statushamster, block, round
/claimbest batch + dust
/mergecheckSqueeks off cooldown
/laddermerge plan + power gain
/threshold 0.5claim alert level
/block on|offblock notifications
/digest on|offdaily summary
/quiet 22:00-07:00sleep hours
/lang vi|enlanguage

How it works

Three steps, no wallet connection needed for alerts.

  1. Find the bot by its Telegram username and press /start. No invite is required.

  2. Add a wallet with /watch 0x… label. The bot only reads public chain data for that address.

  3. Get pinged when something matters. To act, the bot links you to the official Squeekchain app; signing always happens in your own wallet.

Security

The bot never asks for a seed phrase or private key and cannot sign transactions. It stores only your Telegram ID, the wallet addresses you add, and your alert settings. /delete wipes everything.
